Bring Your Own Builder

Choose your homesite, bring the builder you trust, and build in the Herriman foothills.

How It Works

Three Steps to a Custom Home

Choose Your Homesite

Pick the homesite and the view that speak to you, and reserve it with Panorama.

Choose Your Builder

Bring the builder you already know and trust to build your home at Panorama.

Design & Build

Your builder designs and builds to the Panorama Design Guidelines, the standard every home in the community meets: upgraded landscaping, fencing requirements, decking details and more.

For You and Your Builder

Panorama Design Guidelines

Every home at Panorama is held to a higher standard. The guidelines set out the landscaping, fencing, decking and design details your builder will need to follow. Hand them to your builder before you start.
